title: Detecting Magnon-Phonon Coupling with STEM-EELS
content: Magnons are quantized collective excitations that propagate as waves of precessing magnetic moments within a material. These excitations hold considerable promise as information carriers due to their potential to transmit signals over macroscopic distances with minimal ohmic losses [1]. This makes magnons an attractive candidate for next-generation data transmission technologies, enabling low-energy, high-speed information transfer. To fully realize the practical applications of magnon-based technologies, a deeper understanding of how the atomic bonding and local structure of a material influence magnon behavior is essential.
